question: Which read-tool relevance adapters preserve evidence, and where does the added semantic work help?

protocol.label: Controlled-fixture development confirmation, one paired trial; no agent-routing benchmark
protocol.evidence: Complete selected responses, all source continuations; no automatic source hydration.
protocol.metrics: Full incurred response tokens; predeclared verification-read response tokens separately (zero if no such read); provider receipts separately. Target-string arrival is a diagnostic, never semantic sufficiency.
protocol.verification: Exact verifier reads are fixed in the case catalog before provider results, repeated in each arm, and counted in full. Their anchors are supplied by the fixture author; they do not measure autonomous routing or avoided reads.
protocol.adjudication: Review every observed prefix for semantic adequacy. Metadata can answer candidate identity only. No score-based verdicts, no evidence filtering, Unknown and worse outcomes retained.
protocol.priorEvidence: localFetch/localSearch use preserved prior real-model studies because the shared judge/windowing was not changed; current binaries still receive fresh mechanical acceptance.

finalVerification.method: Canonical equality of state/questions/model; provider controls/auth and transport are not evidence. Final targeted capture includes same requests among broader deterministic controls. No paid rerun.

correctness.sourceLineRecovery: Every original line recovered via emitted optional read leads or exact judged source anchors. Optional contextual reads may overlap; continuation edges and provider state/question packets do not repeat.
correctness.rankingContinuationProviderWork: Each nested walk ranks its five initial files once; later file pages and exact verification reads do not rank again.

repairs: File/match pagination diamond replaced with one linear executable continuation chain.
Hydrated clasify advances outer file pages without replaying already hydrated match pages.

calibration.kind: Deterministic development fixture assertion repair, not a new model impact trial.
calibration.correction: Search candidates still require one row per file; hydrated rows are judged or explicitly unjudged windows. Corrected checks assert distinct scopes, source coverage, executable unjudged leads, and no repeated classification packets, instead of imposing one row per file or forced deferral when the budget fits.

architectureVerification.cause: clasify imported the outer-page constructor directly from local_search; shared tool logic belongs in a neutral module.
architectureVerification.repair: Shared outer-file pagination constructor moved into tools/paging.rs; localSearch and clasify depend on the neutral module. No boundary allowlist exception.
architectureVerification.limits: Full34/34 older local and15/15 all-tool localSearch runs remain retained from the immediately preceding build. After neutral helper extraction only the affected tied pagination and nested hydration cases were repeated; paid impact was not rerun.

rows.adjudication: No new paid trial. Fresh mechanical acceptance; prior local studies remain baseline-limited and the strongest tested exact controls won.

Returned healthMarker lines omit the prefix behavior. Greeter remains on page2. The same pinned greeter lines11–18 verifier is required in each arm. No saved read; exact text/path control used zero calls.

The complete answer sentence at line66 moved from ordinary page5 to ranked page2. Complete traversal still costs more, and the exact phrase control supplies it in one zero-call response.
The target commit was already on page1. The same pinned patch verifier confirms the added implementation in every arm; no read was avoided. Path-filtered control used zero calls.
Section and patch order are protected. Both queries skip classification; a skip receipt still adds response tokens.

sourceAdequacy.method: Post-result manual source sufficiency; no solver stopping observation, calibrated judge, or held-out generalization. All incurred work remains charged. Other behavior cases use frozen oracle-provided source verifiers and establish no avoided read.

limitations: Single development-fixture pair per newly checked tool; not an agent benchmark or representative distribution.
All 13 receive fresh mechanics; localFetch/localSearch prior real-model findings are not rerun or pooled with new model results.
Exact control anchors and verifier reads were authored before model outputs; they do not measure autonomous discovery. LSP definition control is not caller-behavior-equivalent.
No financial or whole-agent saving claim; caller response, source read, loaded schema, and provider tokens are distinct costs.
Every request used jev-latest and every response reported jev-1.13.0; future alias resolution can change.
Zero-call skips still add receipts and sometimes repeated goals in continuation payloads.
